title: Value of the discriminant
source: Theory P1-1.8 Quick check 1 (discriminant of x^2-8x+7 is 36); book Key point 1.5 p.24, new numbers

steps.name: A
steps.note: For (x-p)(x-q)=x^2-(p+q)x+pq, the discriminant is (p-q)^2. Original p=7, q=1 gives x^2-8x+7 and D=36.

contexts.note: Includes the original p=7, q=1, giving x^2-8x+7 and discriminant 36

title: Parameter for a repeated root
source: Theory P1-1.8 Quick check 2 (x^2-8x+k=0 has a repeated root when k=16); book Worked example 1.18 style p.25, new numbers
stem: Find the value of \(k\) for which \(x^2-{B|int}x+k=0\) has a repeated root.

steps.name: A
steps.note: B=2h, so (2h)^2-4k=0 gives k=h^2. Original h=4, B=8, K=16.

title: Positive parameter for a repeated root
source: Theory P1-1.8 Quick check 3 (x^2+kx+9=0 has a repeated root at k=6 or k=-6; the positive value is 6); book Worked example 1.19 style, new numbers
stem: The equation \(x^2+kx+{C|int}=0\) has a repeated root. What is the positive value of \(k\)?

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: \(k^2-4\times {C|int}=0\), so the positive value of \(k\) is \({K|int}\).
steps.note: C=s^2, so k=+-2s. The positive value is 2s. Original s=3, C=9, K=6.

contexts.note: Includes the original s=3, C=9, K=6

title: Values of k for no real roots

source.note: Stem taken from the QP PDF (UCLES 2022), Question 3(a) only. Official answer and mark allocation from the MS PDF. The item is paper/self-mark. Part (b) is a trigonometric equation and is omitted.

stem:
This question is 9709/12/O/N/22 Question 3(a), taken from the official QP.

Find the set of values of \(k\) for which the equation \(8x^2+kx+2=0\) has no real roots.  [2]

steps.name: M
steps.text_tex: The discriminant is \(k^2-4\times 8\times 2=k^2-64\). For no real roots, \(k^2-64<0\).
steps.note: MS: M1 for use of b^2-4ac but not just in the quadratic formula.

steps.name: A
steps.note: MS: -8 < k < 8, or equivalent open-interval notation. Independent check: k^2 < 64 iff -8 < k < 8.
